title: Vehicle begins route at start_index 0
description: A vehicle anchored at start_index 0 serves a single job at another index.
expectedResult: 200; status Ok; result.code==0; J1 assigned; result.unassigned empty

title: Vehicle starts at the last valid location index (boundary)
description: start_index set to len(location)-1 is accepted as the last valid anchor.
expectedResult: 200; result.code==0; J1 assigned; result.unassigned empty

title: Closed route returns to its origin depot
description: end_index equal to start_index forces the vehicle back to its origin.
expectedResult: 200; result.code==0; J1 assigned; route ends at location_index 0 (== start_index)

title: Open route with end_index omitted finishes at the last task
description: Omitting end_index yields an open route that ends at its last served task.
expectedResult: 200; result.code==0; J1 assigned; open route (no fixed end) ends at last task

title: Onboard load within a single-dimension capacity is served
description: A pickup quantity below capacity keeps onboard load within the bound.
expectedResult: 200; result.code==0; J1 assigned; onboard load <= 100 at every step

title: Demand exactly equal to capacity is feasible (boundary)
description: A pickup quantity equal to capacity is at-the-limit and still assignable.
expectedResult: 200; result.code==0; J1 assigned; onboard load == 50 (<= capacity) at the pickup step

title: Route completes within the vehicle shift window
description: A 09:00-17:00 shift comfortably contains the route for one job.
expectedResult: 200; result.code==0; J1 assigned; route end <= 61200

title: Feasible route inside a tight shift window
description: A short 09:00-10:00 shift still contains a single nearby job.
expectedResult: 200; result.code==0; J1 assigned; route end <= 36000

title: Job served at a valid location index
description: A job referencing an in-range location_index is served.
expectedResult: 200; result.code==0; J1 assigned; result.unassigned empty

title: Job at the last valid location index (boundary)
description: location_index == len(location)-1 is the last valid reference.
expectedResult: 200; result.code==0; J1 assigned; result.unassigned empty

title: Pickup quantity carried onward within capacity
description: A single pickup below capacity is carried without breaching the bound.
expectedResult: 200; result.code==0; J1 assigned; onboard load <= 5 at every step

title: Two pickups stack within capacity
description: Two pickups whose combined load fits capacity are both carried.
expectedResult: 200; result.code==0; J1 and J2 assigned; cumulative onboard load <= 10 at every step

title: Arrival falls within the job time window (early arrival waits)
description: A job window inside the shift is honored; early arrival waits to window start.
expectedResult: 200; result.code==0; J1 assigned; job start within [36000, 43200]

title: Job with multiple allowed windows is served in one of them
description: Two non-overlapping windows are offered; the job is served in one.
expectedResult: 200; result.code==0; J1 assigned; job start within one of [36000,39600] or [46800,50400]

title: Shipment pickup and delivery on one vehicle, pickup first
description: A shipment with distinct pickup and delivery indices is co-assigned to one vehicle.
expectedResult: 200; result.code==0; shipment S1 assigned; pickup served before delivery on the same vehicle

title: Pickup step starts within its time window
description: A pickup constrained to a window is served within that window.
expectedResult: 200; result.code==0; shipment S1 assigned; pickup step starts within [36000, 43200]

title: Delivery step served after pickup at its index
description: The delivery step at a distinct index is served after the pickup.
expectedResult: 200; result.code==0; shipment S1 assigned; delivery served after pickup

title: Delivery index equal to pickup index is valid (boundary, zero-distance)
description: A shipment whose delivery index equals its pickup index is accepted.
expectedResult: 200; result.code==0; shipment S1 assigned; delivery index == pickup index accepted

title: Carried amount stays within capacity between the two steps
description: A shipment amount below capacity is carried from pickup to delivery.
expectedResult: 200; result.code==0; shipment S1 assigned; onboard load <= 5 between pickup and delivery

title: Multi-dimension shipment amount consistent with capacity
description: A 2-D amount matches a 2-D capacity and stays within both bounds.
expectedResult: 200; result.code==0; shipment S1 assigned; onboard load <= [10,10] on both dimensions

title: Global lateness tolerance permits a slightly late arrival
description: A 600s global tolerance lets a job be served just after its window closes.
expectedResult: 200; result.code==0; J1 assigned; arrival within window end + 600s tolerance

title: Zero global tolerance with on-time arrival
description: With max_visit_lateness 0 a job reachable inside its window is still served.
expectedResult: 200; result.code==0; J1 assigned; arrival within [36000,43200] (no lateness used)

title: Global tolerance applied across multiple jobs
description: A shared 1800s tolerance covers small lateness on two windowed jobs.
expectedResult: 200; result.code==0; J1 and J2 assigned; each arrival within its window end + 1800s

title: Generous tolerance enables an otherwise-tight assignment
description: A large global tolerance rescues a job whose window ends just before arrival.
expectedResult: 200; result.code==0; J1 assigned; served within window end + 7200s tolerance

title: in_sequence relation orders two jobs on one vehicle
description: An in_sequence relation with two job steps enforces their served order.
expectedResult: 200; result.code==0; J1 and J2 assigned; J1 served before J2 on the same vehicle (as the relation mandates)

title: in_sequence relation begins at the vehicle start step
description: A start step precedes a job step within an in_sequence relation.
expectedResult: 200; result.code==0; J1 assigned; vehicle start step precedes J1 (as the relation mandates)

title: in_sequence relation ends at the vehicle end step
description: A job step precedes an end step within an in_sequence relation.
expectedResult: 200; result.code==0; J1 assigned; vehicle end step follows J1 (as the relation mandates)

title: in_sequence relation with a shipment pickup step
description: A pickup step referencing a shipment precedes a job step in an in_sequence relation.
expectedResult: 200; result.code==0; shipment S1 and J1 assigned; shipment pickup step precedes J1 (as the relation mandates)

title: in_sequence relation with a shipment delivery step
description: A pickup step precedes its delivery step within an in_sequence relation.
expectedResult: 200; result.code==0; shipment S1 assigned; delivery step follows pickup step (as the relation mandates)

title: in_sequence relation chains start, jobs, and end
description: A full ordered chain (start -> J1 -> J2 -> end) is enforced by one in_sequence relation.
expectedResult: 200; result.code==0; J1 and J2 assigned; steps served in listed order start->J1->J2->end (as the relation mandates)

title: Capacity and time windows satisfied together on two vehicles
description: Windowed, capacitated jobs are served across two vehicles within all bounds.
expectedResult: 200; result.code==0; every job assigned XOR unassigned; for any assigned job onboard load <= capacity on every dimension at every step and job start within its window

title: Two shipments respect precedence, capacity, and windows together
description: Two windowed shipments are co-scheduled within capacity, each pickup before its delivery.
expectedResult: 200; result.code==0; for any assigned shipment its pickup precedes its delivery on the same vehicle and onboard load <= 10 at every step

title: start_index equal to len(location) is rejected
description: A start_index equal to the array length is out of range at submit.
expectedResult: 400 input validation failed; no id returned; error names start_index out of range

title: end_index out of range is rejected
description: An end_index beyond the array length is out of range at submit.
expectedResult: 400 input validation failed; no id returned; error names end_index out of range

title: Pickup exceeding every vehicle's capacity is unassigned
description: A single pickup larger than all capacity is accepted but cannot be served.
expectedResult: 200; result.code==0; J1 in result.unassigned with a capacity reason

title: Vehicle time_window with start greater than end is rejected
description: A shift whose start exceeds its end is a malformed window at submit.
expectedResult: 400 input validation failed; no id returned; error names time_window start > end

title: Job location_index equal to len(location) is rejected
description: A job index equal to the array length is out of range at submit.
expectedResult: 400 input validation failed; no id returned; error names the out-of-range location_index

title: Two pickups that cannot be carried together leave one unassigned
description: Two pickups whose combined load exceeds the single vehicle's capacity cannot both be onboard.
expectedResult: 200; result.code==0; the two pickups cannot be onboard together; at least one of J1/J2 in result.unassigned with a capacity reason

title: Unreachable window with zero lateness leaves the job unassigned
description: A window that closes before the earliest possible arrival, with no lateness tolerance, is infeasible.
expectedResult: 200; result.code==0; J1 in result.unassigned with a time-window reason

title: Shipment pickup location_index out of range is rejected
description: A pickup index beyond the array length is out of range at submit.
expectedResult: 400 input validation failed; no id returned; error names the out-of-range pickup location_index

title: Delivery window earlier than pickup window makes the pair infeasible
description: A delivery window that precedes the pickup window violates precedence, so both steps go unassigned.
expectedResult: 200; result.code==0; both shipment steps (S1P and S1D) in result.unassigned (precedence infeasible)

title: Two shipments that cannot be onboard together defer one
description: Two shipment amounts whose sum exceeds capacity cannot be carried simultaneously.
expectedResult: 200; result.code==0; the two shipments cannot be onboard together; at least one shipment in result.unassigned with a capacity reason

title: Negative max_visit_lateness is rejected
description: max_visit_lateness must be a non-negative integer; a negative value is malformed at submit.
expectedResult: 400 input validation failed; no id returned; negative max_visit_lateness rejected (violates non-negative integer constraint)

title: Relation step with an unknown step type is rejected
description: A relation step whose type is outside the allowed set is a malformed value at submit.
expectedResult: 400 input validation failed; no id returned; unknown relation step type rejected

title: Request without the key query parameter is unauthorized
description: The API key is a query parameter; omitting it rejects the request before any solve.
testData: POST /optimization/v2  (the 'key' query parameter is omitted; body is otherwise valid)
expectedResult: 401 key missing/invalid; no id returned; request rejected at submit before solving

title: Malformed JSON body is rejected
description: A syntactically invalid JSON payload is rejected as an input validation failure.
testData: POST /optimization/v2 body: { "locations": { "location": ["34.0522, -118.2437" }  <-- unbalanced braces / malformed JSON
expectedResult: 400 input validation failed; no id returned; malformed JSON rejected at submit

title: Missing required top-level vehicles is rejected
description: A request omitting the required vehicles array is an input validation failure.
expectedResult: 400 input validation failed; no id returned; missing required top-level 'vehicles' rejected
